subject: Request: accelerated RSU vesting + one-time hire stipend for Olivia Turner
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation: Olivia Turner - counteroffer requires sign-on and accelerated RSU

Team —

Quick summary: Olivia Turner (Sr. LLM SWE, candidate for Staff Inference) has received an external counteroffer from a competitor with a 20% cash uplift and an accelerated first-year RSU schedule. Manager (Elias) is asking whether we can offer a one-time sign-on stipend plus accelerated vesting on part of the RSU grant to close.

Key details:
- Role: Staff Inference Engineer (IC5 equivalent) — hiring manager: Elias Nakamura
- Base / target comp: $210k / $310k OTE (on-band)
- Standard RSU grant: 24-month cliff? (standard package is 4-year with 1-year cliff) — current offer uses 4y/1y schedule
- Candidate request: $15k one-time sign-on (cash) + 25% of 1st-year RSUs to vest at 6 months (to match competitor timeline)
- Time pressure: candidate needs an answer by EOD Friday (3/4) to remain engaged

Attachments: Offer_Letter_Olivia_Turner.pdf (draft, includes standard comp), comp_comparison_20280301.xlsx (market check)

Ask: Can comp/people approve a one-time stipend + accelerated partial vesting off-band for this candidate? If approved, we will require a 12-month retention clause and manager sign-off on the hiring note. Prefer guidance on max stipend and whether accelerated vesting at 6 months is acceptable precedent.

Thanks —

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Sr. Recruiting Partner, Engineering
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

[Attachment: comp_comparison_20280301.xlsx] (XLSX, 48KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Olivia Turner - counteroffer requires sign-on and accelerated RSU

Thanks for the context, Soojin. A couple quick questions before I escalate to comp:

1) Is the manager comfortable with a 12-month retention clause tied to the stipend/accelerated vesting? If not, we should decline.
2) Where does the candidate fall in the band (mid/top)? I know you noted on-band but want explicit band placement for approval thresholds.
3) Any history of similar exceptions in the last 12 months in Inference org (I recall one for Nora Patel last year but need comp to confirm).

If manager sign-off + retention clause are ok, I can fast-track to comp. Otherwise, let's offer a smaller stipend and stronger retention language.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Talent Programs (Hiring Ops)
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Olivia Turner - counteroffer requires sign-on and accelerated RSU

Vanessa / Soojin —

Reviewed the comp/market materials and comp history. Recommendation (conditional approval):

- One-time sign-on stipend: approve up to $12,500 (gross, lump-sum). This is out-of-band but within allowable ad-hoc stipend authority for critical IC hires in Inference.
- Accelerated vesting: approve the acceleration of up to 25% of the first-year RSU to vest at 6 months, provided the overall grant value remains on-band and total up-front value does not exceed 30% of the annual LTI delivery.
- Conditions: candidate must sign within 72 hours of the revised offer; inclusion of a 12-month pro-rated clawback/repayment clause for the stipend and the accelerated portion of RSUs if employee leaves within 12 months; manager (Elias) must confirm operational need and retention plan.

I have attached a comp-comparison and a short precedent note. If the manager confirms and recruiting adds the retention language, Comp approves routing to GC for any legal review of the clause.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Compensation & Rewards
Redwood Inference

Olivia —

Following up with an updated offer. Please see the note below from Comp (Marissa). We can amend the draft offer as follows if you are willing to sign within 72 hours: a one-time sign-on stipend of $12,500 and an acceleration of 25% of the first-year RSUs to vest at 6 months. The stipend and accelerated RSU portion will be subject to a 12-month pro-rated clawback if you leave before 12 months.

If this works, we will send an updated DocuSign for signature and the retention clause will be inserted into the offer. Please confirm you can sign within 72 hours so we can lock this in.
